review_notes: FIXED: Scene 2: "Historically, US Treasury bonds yielded about two percent real return." (The exact figure of 2% real return is not supported by the cited sources and likely oversimplifies long‑term averages.)
FIXED: Scene 7: "The 1980s brought aggressive rate cuts." (During the 1980s the Fed actually maintained high rates; cuts occurred later, making this statement historically inaccurate.)
